scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Conditional rule ensembles: learn decision rules (if-then) conditioned on feature subspaces, then ensemble them. Uses sklearn's DecisionTreeClassifier with rule extraction.

H69_RULE_ENSEMBLES.question: Does a conditional rule ensemble (decision rules conditioned on feature subspaces) improve fold-0 OOF AUC on the rich view?
H69_RULE_ENSEMBLES.method: Train multiple shallow DecisionTrees (max_depth=3) on random feature subspaces of the rich view (folds 1-4). Extract decision rules from each tree. Combine rules via weighted voting (weights from fold-1-4 AUC). Predict fold-0. Measure fold-0 port_delta vs champion proxy.
H69_RULE_ENSEMBLES.leakage: Trees trained on FIT only (folds 1-4). Rule extraction on FIT only. Fold-safe.
H69_RULE_ENSEMBLES.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
